rules: The learner consumes observed source support/query arrays and its own numerical solutions only.
No input groups, group sizes, roles, filter count, teacher coefficients, permutation, analytic indexator, or teacher-shaped wiring is available to discovery or selection.
A dense ReLU MLP, magnitude pruning, neuron-symmetry alignment and clustering of cross-task weight profiles are generic modeling choices, not an absence of all inductive bias.
Pruning fractions and code counts form generic geometric grids; select by source-task predictive quality, never by agreement with the teacher.
Discovery uses tasks 0-7; source tasks 8-9 select compression and numerical settings; tasks 10-11 are a source audit only.
All transfer methods learn numerical coefficients from fresh random initialization, including controls with identical masks and without weight sharing.
Freeze settings and the bank before creating independent target tasks. Target query chooses a restart/checkpoint only; target test never chooses the procedure.
Compare AR with bank sampling, one indexator, independent token frequencies, shuffled structure, mask-only and dense MLP.
Report a failure to discover a useful transferable structure without substituting an analytic architecture. No software tests are created or run.
